items.headline: Albemarle Rises on Earnings as Global Lithium Demand Grows Faster Than Expected
items.snippet: Stock rising after Q2 beat. CEO Masters cites improved pricing, specialty division performance, cost discipline. ~$100M annualized cost savings achieved, tracking to high end of $100-150M target. ~$70-90M negative supply chain impact expected from Middle East situation this year.

items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Q2 2026 Earnings Call on Aug 6, 2026 - Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand growth continues to outstrip supply growth. As a result, we exited the second quarter near record lows in terms of days of lithium salt inventory. Global lithium consumption was up 45% year-over-year through May, driven by continued strength in stationary storage.

items.headline: ALBEMARLE CORP files FORM 8-K on Aug 5, 2026
items.snippet: 2026 outlook scenarios: sales volumes 225-235 kilotons LCE; three lithium price scenarios ($10/$20/$30 per kg LCE) yielding Energy Storage net sales of $2.5-6.1B and adjusted EBITDA of $0.7-4.1B depending on pricing.

items.headline: Albemarle Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: Q2 2026 beat on EPS and sales. Energy Storage market price scenarios detailed; Specialties outlook improved on bromine specialties volume growth and cost/productivity initiatives.

items.headline: ALBEMARLE CORP files FORM 10-Q for Q2 FY2026 on Aug 5, 2026
items.snippet: Lithium index pricing beginning to rebound from lows. Company monitoring Middle East situation (shipping/raw material delays); minimal direct tariff exposure expected.

items.headline: Here's How to Play Albemarle Stock Before Q2 Earnings Release
items.snippet: ALB down 16.1% YTD vs Zacks Chemical-Diversified +17.6% and S&P 500 +9.5%. SQM -2.6%, RIO +19.8% YTD. Zacks rates Hold given stretched valuation despite volume growth.
